findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "connect_account" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_deal, get_mutual_action_plan, get_login_url · Private data: get_stakeholders, get_deal, get_login_url, connect_account · Public sink: analyze_deal, share_deal · Destructive: get_deal_risks.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_deal, get_mutual_action_plan, get_login_url · Private data: get_stakeholders, get_deal, get_login_url, connect_account · Public sink: analyze_deal, share_deal · Destructive: get_deal_risks

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
